signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.lead: Sign in to open your business.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lead: We will email you a code to check it is really you.
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.checkLead: We sent a 6-digit code. Type it below.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Type the email or phone number you sign in with. We will send you a link to make a new password.
forgot.contactMissing: Type your email or phone number first.
forgot.sentLead: If {contact} has an account, a link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.
forgot.sentHelp: Nothing came? Look in your spam folder, or try again in a few minutes.

reset.title: Make a new password
reset.lead: Use at least 8 letters or numbers. You will be signed out on every other device.
reset.tooShort: Use at least 8 letters or numbers.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
reset.done: Password saved. You are signed out on every other device.
reset.usedLead: A password was already made with this link. If that was not you, ask for a new link now.
reset.expiredLead: Links work for 1 hour. Ask for a new one and try again.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.lead: Make a password to start using your account.
invite.tooShort: Use at least 8 letters or numbers.
invite.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

onboarding.title: What is your business called?
onboarding.lead: Customers and your team will see this name.
onboarding.name: Business name
onboarding.nameMissing: Type your business name to continue.
